soulbound.powers.feather.title: Feather
soulbound.powers.feather.description1: You are as light as a feather! Taking no fall damage and dashing wherever you look!
soulbound.abilities.feather_dash.title: Dash
soulbound.abilities.feather_dash.descrip: Dash in the direction you are looking. Cooldown: 2 minutes.
soulbound.powers.poison.title: Poison
soulbound.powers.poison.description1: Your fists carry a toxic touch, giving you a chance to poison those you strike!
soulbound.debuffs.poison.regeneration_ch: Chance to inflict Regeneration instead of Poison
soulbound.abilities.poison.title: Toxic Touch
soulbound.abilities.poison.description: Punch your target with an empty hand for a 30% chance to inflict Poison for 10 seconds.
soulbound.powers.frozen.title: Frozen
soulbound.powers.frozen.description1: You bring winter wherever you walk! Freeze your foes with your fists and turn water beneath you into ice.
soulbound.abilities.frozen.title: Freeze
soulbound.abilities.frozen.description: Punch an opponent with an empty hand for a 25% chance to freeze them in place for 5 seconds.
soulbound.powers.growth.title: Growth
soulbound.powers.growth.description1: Nature flourishes in your presence! Crops grow at your command, and harvesting them yields a greater bounty.
soulbound.abilities.growth.title: Rooted Shield
soulbound.abilities.growth.description: Summon a spherical shield of mangrove roots around yourself.
soulbound.powers.fire.title: Fire
soulbound.powers.fire.description1: Lava is no obstacle to you! Walk across it by turning it into harmless magma and shrug off the flames with ease.
soulbound.abilities.fire.title: Inferno
soulbound.abilities.fire.description: Cook every cookable item in your inventory instantly. Cooldown: 10 minutes.
soulbound.powers.thunder.title: Thunder
soulbound.powers.thunder.description1: The storm answers to you! Smite your enemies while the skies around you are forever clear.
soulbound.abilities.thunder.title: Stormsense
soulbound.abilities.thunder.description: Reveal whether you have the required item in your inventory to unleash a smite.
soulbound.powers.water.title: Water
soulbound.powers.water.description1: The depths are your home! Breathe and mine underwater with ease, protected by the power of the conduit.
soulbound.abilities.water.title: Drown
soulbound.abilities.water.description: Surround the head of a targeted player with water, drowning them for 25 seconds. Range: 15 blocks. Cooldown: 5 minutes.
soulbound.powers.necromancy.title: Necromancy
soulbound.powers.necromancy.description1: Death is only the beginning! Raise fallen mobs you've slain as loyal undead companions using their remains.
soulbound.abilities.necromancy.title: Raise Dead
soulbound.abilities.necromancy.descripti: Use a fresh mob drop from a mob you personally killed to resurrect it as a loyal companion. Drops expire after 30 minutes.
soulbound.powers.invisibility.title: Invisibility
soulbound.powers.invisibility.descriptio: Become completely unseen! Even your armor, tools, and presence in death messages vanish with you.
soulbound.abilities.invisibility.title: Vanish
soulbound.abilities.invisibility.descrip: Become completely invisible for 3 minutes. Cooldown: 30 minutes.
soulbound.powers.swap.title: Swap
soulbound.powers.swap.description1: Mark another player as your target and, when the time is right, trade places with them from afar.
soulbound.abilities.swap.title: Swap
soulbound.abilities.swap.description: Swap places with your marked target. The mark lasts for 15 minutes and is shown by spore blossom particles.
